name: Capclave
blurb: A small, relaxed DC-area literary convention focused on short fiction, with Guests of Honor, readings and a dealer's room; successor to Disclave.
notes: Capclave 2026 (October 2-4, 2026, per the official site) concluded just before today's cutoff (2026-10-05), so it falls outside the tracking window. The site is still on the dated path capclave.org/capclave26/ with no capclave27 subsite yet, so 2027 dates are not announced. 2026's Guests of Honor were Nino Cipri and Rebecca Roanhorse, noted here for reference only (not an emitted edition).
